sources: assert strings (pristine 2276): bitmap_extract.c 0x6a6-0x6b2 (source/destination_bitmap->width/height/depth/type/mipmap_count/flags), bitmaps.c 0x20e 'bitmap->base_address' @0x7c98a/0x75024, FUN_00077120 '!bitmap->hardware_format' @0x7737c, xbox_texture_cache.c 0x187 'texture->bitmap->cache_block_index==block_index'

texture_cache_bitmap_new 0x1be960, extract_pixels_to_mipmap 0x74210, extract_pixels_from_mipmap 0x745c0, extract_mipmaps_to_bitmap 0x74fb0, bitmap_2d_address 0x7c940, rasterizer_bitmap_2d_changed 0x168500

stride.evidence: element size of the bitm tag's bitmap_data block (tag_block_get_element @0x1355b7)

fields.evidence: bitmap_2d_new/3d/cube store the constant 0x6269746d ('bitm') here after csmemset

fields.name: format
fields.evidence: assert 'slice_bitmap->format==source_bitmap->format'; bitmap_2d_new stores its format argument as a word at +0xc; MOVSX word [reg+0xc] in rasterizer_bitmap_2d_changed

fields.name: flags
fields.evidence: assert TEST_FLAG(bitmap->flags, ...); bitmap_2d_new stores a word (0x40/0x41) and ORs bytes; MOVZX word [reg+0xe] @0x7d470. Bits: 0 has_power_of_two_dimensions (rasterizer_xbox_hardware_bitmaps.c 0x34), 1 compressed (bitmap_extract.c TEST), 3 swizzled (bitmap_extract.c 0x6ae), 4 linear (bitmaps.c 0x263), 7 cached (xbox_texture_cache.c 0x86)
MOVSX word [reg+0x10] @0x75380/0x75e70; bitmap_utilities.c halves it as a word pair with +0x12 ((v+1)/2), otherwise copies the pair as one dword
MOVSX word [reg+0x12] @0x75380/0x75e70; second half of the +0x10 pair
texture_cache_bitmap_new: ADD [bm+0x18], [tag+0x38] (relative -> absolute pixel offset); 32-bit MOV/SUB in FUN_00077120
texture_cache_bitmap_new stores the bitmap_get_pixel_data_size result here; 32-bit MOV @0x1be960/0x1bf180/0x1bf570
texture_cache_bitmap_new stores its tag_index argument; FUN_001beb70 passes it to tag_get_name; 32-bit MOV/CMP

fields.name: cache_block_index
fields.evidence: assert 'texture->bitmap->cache_block_index==block_index' (xbox_texture_cache.c 0x187) compares dword [bitmap+0x24]; NONE stored on release

fields.name: hardware_format
fields.evidence: assert '!bitmap->hardware_format' @0x7737c follows MOV EAX,[ESI+0x28]/TEST; assert text 'IDirect3DTexture8_LockRect((IDirect3DTexture8*)bitmap->hardware_format' with the +0x28 pointer passed to D3D (rasterizer_bitmap_2d_changed)

fields.name: base_address
fields.evidence: assert 'bitmap->base_address' @0x7c98a follows MOV EAX,[EBX+0x2c]/TEST/JNE; bitmap_2d_new stores the debug_malloc result at +0x2c

notes: Flag bit 2 (value 4) is set for format 0x11 in bitmap_2d_new but has no assert-proven name; bits 5, 6 (0x40 is stored by bitmap_2d_new) and the high byte are unnamed.
+0x10/+0x12 are left unnamed: the 'halve when group flag 8 set' behavior does not prove a semantic name.
+0x18/+0x1c/+0x20 are left unnamed (field_xx): the stores prove role, not a string-backed name.
+0x16..0x17 never observed accessed as a bitmap_data field (0x75a20/0x76790 hits at 0x16/0x1a are other structs).
